native_current_control_scope.original_source_scope: Unofficial candidate votes, not ballots, unique voters, party registration or demographic turnout. Party labels and candidate names are literal, including independents and fusion lines; no inferred affiliation. County party totals aggregate only actual county fragments. State party totals include all declared district candidate votes in accepted states, including unlocated returns; an invalid district withholds its entire state rather than publishing a partial state total. Withheld county states retain missing located counts. Absent parties have no invented zero rows; explicitly reported zero candidate votes remain zero.
native_current_control_scope.source_precedence: County tables use complete official vectors for Monroe, Bucks and Montgomery. Provider-only state and district tables remain unchanged and omit those known write-ins; they are separate source scopes, not recomputed composite totals.
